senses.gloss:
श्चुत् श्चुत्, and 1. श्च्युत् श्च्युत् (derived from a noun based on श्च्यु, cf. च्यु), i. 1, Par. To ooze, to drop, Kir. 5, 29 (श्च्युत्); to distill, Mālat. 81, 13 (श्चुत्).
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. श्च्युतित.
 1. Shed, sprinkled.
 2. Dropping, flowing.
 --With the prep. उप उप, To drop, Chr. 293, 2 = Rigv. i. 87, 2 (श्चुत्).
 --With नि नि, श्चुत्, To drop down, Mālat. 128, 5.
 --With प्र प्र, To distill, Mālat. 24, 3; Bhaṭṭ. 14, 79 (श्चुत्).
 --Cf. Goth. skevjan (= श्चु); skura; A.S. scur.
